'''Ruhnuk''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] surrounded by an ionic storm. Due to the world's dry, arid climate it was prone to [[Sandstorm/Legends|duststorms]].<ref name="TOR" /> [[Heta Kol]] and the [[Hidden Chain]] had established a base of operations there, sometime after their [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] on the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]''.<ref name="Spirit">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref> The planet was contested between the Hidden Chain and the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] during the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]]<ref name="Showdown">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref> around [[3625 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.2}}</ref>
